notes.title: Launch day fast approaching!
notes.content:
Princess Ursula will be launched in just three weeks! I'm nervous and excited about it. Lately we have finished integrating the Brazilian Portuguese language, gave some keys to content creators and are trying hard to do promotion for the game here and there.

I got contacted about a possible Spanish translation. I don't know if it will happen before launch or if it will happen at all but I think that would be lovely.

Stay tuned for more news!
